hero.metaDescription: Learn how I work, what I prioritise in client projects, and how ITOS helps businesses with websites, CRM, and automation.

image.alt: Portrait of Olga from IT Optimal Solutions

paragraphs: I've been working in IT for over 15 years — and I still love that moment when a complex problem turns into a working solution.

I started as a programmer, then became a business analyst, led a development team, and eventually founded and ran my own IT company in Belarus. Then I moved to Sweden and kept growing — web development, automation, Python, AI tools. Now I run my own company, IT Optimal Solutions, in Sweden.
I help small and medium-sized businesses build their online presence, implement the right tools, and eliminate the routine that eats up time, money — and often nerves.

I don't break processes that work. I adapt them. Automation for the sake of automation is not my thing. What matters to me is a tangible result: less manual work, fewer mistakes, more time for what actually drives the business forward.
I work in Swedish, English, and Russian — whichever works best for you.
If you want to talk about your problem — feel free to reach out, I'm always happy to help.
